question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: When to reply? Context Sensitive Models to Predict Instructor Interventions in MOOC Forums
answer_rationale: The documents mention evaluation on a corpus of 12 MOOC discussion forums from Coursera.org, which implies non-English data is not exclusively used, as Coursera hosts courses in multiple languages. Additionally, the evaluation is described as being over a diverse dataset to represent MOOCs of varying sizes and instructor styles, suggesting multilingual or non-English content may be included.
